BRYANSTON ASSAULT: Coach Moodley

By: Tarryn Crossman | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

Unique Selling Point:
In 2009 he was dismissed from a prestigious private school for sexual misconduct only to go on and coach at Bryanston High school. Finally in 2018 one girl was brave enough to come forward about her abuse at the hands of Aleshan Moodley. How did this sexual predator operate under the raider for so long?

Aleshan Moodley has been accused of sexually assaulting, physically abusing and raping Tayler Cusens while he was the sports director at Bryanston high school. According to Tayler he started grooming her when she was 13-years-old, while at Bryanston primary. She then left on a Netball Bursary, but 2 years later Moodley offered to get her and her two sisters full scholarships to Bryanston High school. She returned and in the second term of her G10 year the abuse started. It was radical, he physically assaulted her if she tried to get out from under his control.


She eventually told her mom who confronted the school in her G11 year. Three more girls came forward, all four girls made affidavits and were video recorded giving testimony at Bryanston’s labour proceedings over Moodley. But only Tayler continued with the criminal case.

But as Tayler's story has become public knowledge other cases have come out from Trinity Randpark Ridge, a private school

Summary:
Trinity Randpark Ridge
Spoken to the head of sports at the time: Vincent Luksich
He will speak on Camera - his version of events
Moodley was bust in the back room with a "school girl"
Fact: Moodley was in his mid twenties and this girl was 14-years-old
After actually busting them in the back room the principle at the time dismissed Moodley

His CV from Bryanston states that he was employed by Trinity
He informed the SGB - according to the SGB - that he was fired from two other school but they paid him for 6 months to go away. SGB held a disciplinary where he was found guilt if sexually assaulting 4 girls

They then asked Tayler why she was proceeding with Criminal charges as it was over.



Taylor is now 19 years old and she is willing to tell her whole story.
Caitlyn - case study 2 - he tried to assault her on netball tour and then called out of class multiple times and tried to assault her in his office. She was too scared to report.

Nadia is the master in charge of netball at Bryanston. She gave testimony at the trial and is willing to speak
- Relationship between Moodley and Taylor.
- Moodley would call the netball girls out of class on their private phones
- He was warned by the school to stop doing this and they subsequently put a CCTV camera facing his office. They found nothing – don’t think they even looked to be honest

VO: As a parent when you send your child to school the school becomes the in loco Parentas, which means they have a legal responsibility to keep your child safe, to protect them from harm. But more and more in south Africa nothing could be further from the truth

Caitlyn: Bryanston girl not in the criminal case
00:02:04:03 - 00:02:18:14
It was scary because I didn't know, like, what to do or who to talk to
Tayler cusens – criminal case
00:20:35:04 - 00:21:12:05
He threatened me at the beginning, saying that if I told someone I won't be captain.

VO: IN 2019 Bryanston High school made headlines when a first team netball player, Tayler Cusens came forward and accused the then sports director and 1st team netball coach, Aleshan Moodley of grooming her from the age of 11, and then eventually sexually assaulting her in grade 10 and 11

Tayler cusens – Criminal case
It was a father daughter relationship to me. I definitely loved him as a father.

VO: The trial against Aleshan Moodley began in January this year. He is facing 12 counts of sexual assault, assault, and rape. He has pleaded not guilty to all the charges. Moodley has not yet taken the stand in his own defence, as the trial is still on going. But Two years after she first laid charges Tayler Cusens stood up in court


he started calling me out of class in grade 10. he would come to my chair and he would say, pull down your pants. And I'd say no. I pushed him away a few times, but he was stronger than me.
And then he would grab my arms, lift me up and pull them down. he did insert body parts into me and oral things.

Vo: The School Governing Body of Bryanston high school Hired Moodley as the head of sports in 2015. Aidan Hillebrand is the head of the SGB, who is ultimately responsible for the governance of the school

DEREK AND HEAD OF BRYANSTON SGB AIDAN HILLEBRAND
D: What were his qualifications and where was he registered?
A: My understanding was that he had studied sports management and his registration would have been with SACE, which is the South African Council of Educators.
D: But it wasn't checked.
A: No, it wasn't.
D: Is that a failing of the ECB?
A: What had happened was that he had been registered, but he hadn't renewed it, inserted last.

According to Luke Lambrecht of Women and Men against child this was Bryanston High schools first mistake.

Luke and Derek:
L: they employed him without South African Council of Educators registration. They eMPLOYED him without being registrated with the netball federation as a netball coach.
So right at the outset, there's this idea that this person that they've brought into this school is not someone who is equipped or qualified to do the job he's been employed to do.

LINK: After Tayler spoke out two more netball girls came forward one of them has AGREED to speak to us but she has chosen to remain anonymous.

Anon girl – not part of criminal case
We went on tour and one night you invited me to smoke with him in his room. then he started making like weird comments saying, let's go to the bedroom and do things there. And then I started feeling comfortable from there. And as I was about to leave, then he grabbed me and started kissing me.

VO: This student was 16 years old when Moodley allegedly sexually assaulted her

Anon girl – not part of criminal case
I went to his office a few times where he tried where you tried to pull my Spanx down from under my skirt. if you didn't go, he would be rude to you. like, make comments about you or do something to make you feel bad for not going?
I didn't feel like I could trust anyone to tell how they would react to it.

When we contacted Moodley he denied any wrong doing or unlawfulness in this regard

During Moodley’s criminal trial Mrs Johnson the head of netball and a member of the schools senior management team testified under oath that the teachers were complaining to her about Moodley calling girls out of class , prior to Tayler coming forward.

Anon girl – not part of criminal case
when you called us out of class, the teachers knew that we were going to him, but they didn't know what was happening

Mrs Johnson also testified that close to the end of 2018 the school had put up camera’s in the passage where moodleys office and the gym are situated, to monitor their concerns around his behaviour.

Anon girl – not part of criminal case
they spoke to the whole grade. And then they said, you guys are not allowed to go to the Gym. You're not allowed to go in that alleyway type of thing.

Tayler Cusens – Criminal case
they said no girls are allowed in that hallway anymore
But that's all that happened. He was still the netball coach

Aiden and derek
A: The first time it was brought to our attention at the beginning of January in 2019.
every year in the budget, we do have a budget for additional cameras and so we roll out additional cameras all the time
D: where additional cameras rolled out? Because there were suspicions about Mr Moodley behaviour
A: No, they weren't.
D: But the girls were being warned.
Not to loiter around the gym or his office
A: if that's the case, I'm unaware of that.

Luke:
L: There is no reason that you should be calling a child out of the teaching time to go and have individual meetings .
they knew something inappropriate in terms of the behavior the teacher was occurring.
00:23:17:03 - 00:23:21:26
And what did they do to tell the children to behave differently, that close places put up cameras, but they don't discipline him?

As the news about Bryanston high school circulated so new information surfaced about Moodley’s conduct at a prestigious private school, Trinityhouse Randparkridge. Moodley was a previous pupil of the school. He returned as part of the Sports faculty Vincent Luksich was the Vice principle and the head of the sports department at the time. He is now the principle of a prestigious private school inKwazulu natal

00:08:08:09 - 00:08:21:04
when it comes down to his behavior, especially with some of the younger schoolgirls. 00:08:21:21 - 00:08:22:20
What did you notice

I could never say he that his behaviour was out of bounds. He was a good looking chap.
00:08:33:27 - 00:08:43:21
smooth. Sounds a little bit cliched

Jenna-Lee shuttleworth was a 14-year-old pupil at trinityhouse when she first met Moodley who was a 23 years old staff member

Jenna – not part of the criminal case
00:00:35:23 - 00:01:13:19
he became the athletics coach, as far as I remember. And then from being that lady's coach, then he was sort of he became my personal trainer for athletics, which meant that I would come to school significantly earlier before school to train and I would stay after school quite late.
00:01:13:23 - 00:01:17:20
And sometimes I'd actually train on the weekends as well with with him alone.
00:01:27:08 - 00:01:45:18
So I was yeah, I was quite a high achieving athlete for most of my school career

According to Shuttleworth after months of training together Moodley made advances of a sexual nature

Jenna
00:02:51:17 - 00:03:26:00
he pulled me close to him and he kissed me and I resisted. And he said to me that he is in love with me. And if I don't continue this inappropriate relationship with him, that he will stop training me. And being a 14, 15 year old girl and athletics was my life.
00:03:26:02 - 00:03:31:15
I was very scared that this would mean the end of my career. So I went along with it.

Shuttleworth says that Moodley and her become sexually active and the relationship continued for over 6 months

Jenna
00:13:10:03 - 00:13:37:03
He made it very clear to me that if it came out of our relationship, the way that it was came out, that we would be in a lot of trouble. I would obviously be expelled and he would be unable to get another job out of school and he would be fired from Trinity and teaching being his passion.

With regards to Shuttleworth allegation again Moodley denied all wrong doing or unlawfulness

In 2009 Moodly was caught on the school grounds behind locked doors with shuttleworth .

Vincent – Trinity vp
00:11:03:26 - 00:11:35:02
they caught him in the in the storeroom together, which was
00:11:37:00 - 00:11:38:20
very, very irregular.
00:33:11:00 - 00:33:20:05

00:33:20:10 - 00:33:26:29
Yeah, I wouldn't if the way that I looked at it, I wouldn't call it a meeting.
00:16:06:19 - 00:16:42:03
we saw it as a mutual attraction and that it wasn't as if she didn't want to be with him
And we saw actually saw her as the innocent party.
00:16:52:16 - 00:16:53:13
He knew better
00:16:55:12 - 00:16:57:26
weather, we could have expected her to know better.
00:16:57:28 - 00:17:03:05
Possibly

LUKE: 00:33:59:27 - 00:34:34:14
00:15:47:05 - 00:16:20:23
There's absolutely no way that we can blame the girls for the behaviour of adult men if we stop blaming the girls, what we are doing is we are just simply reinforcing the misogynistic patriarchal culture, which is blatantly the basis of the foundation of the rape culture of our country. And that is victim blaming
00:38:43:07 - 00:38:59:24
You need to call it what it is because that is what the law requires. So you can not consent as a child between 12 and 15 to sex with an adult. That is a crime.

Jenna-lee
It was made very, very clear to me that I had done something wrong and that I would be punished for it
And ultimately I was suspended initially and then I was allowed back.


VINCENT:
00:14:05:14 - 00:14:08:25
what action was taken by the school?
00:14:55:04 - 00:14:57:24
the headmaster at the time said.
00:15:00:13 - 00:15:04:02
This can't happen at our school and that
00:15:05:21 - 00:15:32:23
he should leave that was the end of the road at Trinity House


LUKE
00:26:34:21 - 00:27:07:10
What should have happened at that point is he should have been reported in terms of Section 54 for the Sexual Offences Act.


Since this incident took place the school has been bought out by ADVTECH they supplied us with the following information. After a disciplinary hearing was called Moodley resigned of his own accord.
He was never dismissed and The case was never reported to the south African police services

00:29:09:19 - 00:29:19:23
D: according to the law, Vincent, there's an obligation to report it to the police.
00:29:20:18 - 00:29:44:04
I think if you look at the if you look at the situation and and you look at the facts that were placed before the school, that made it difficult. And it did present a gray area, a gray area

DEREK AND LUKE 00:23:52:21 - 00:24:07:24
is it difficult for the schools in terms of the law to take the action talking about if there's not concrete evidence,
LUKE: evidence is the domain of the criminal justice system.
00:24:08:17 - 00:24:39:04
It is not your job to find evidence. It is your job to report what you know, to launch an investigation by the appropriate authorities.
00:24:39:10 - 00:24:45:05
It is not your job. decide what is truth and what is not.

Moodley left trinityhouse with no record of any sexual misconduct. Essentially he had a clean resume and he went on to coach at various primary and high schools in Johannesburg

Bryanston Highschool claims that After the allegations against Moodley were made they took immediate action. They brought in external legal counsel to investigate and an internal disciplinary hearing was held. Two of the girls from Bryanston testified, tayler cusens chose not to participate. Moodley was accused of sexual assault, harassment and financial misconduct

AIDEN: 00:17:42:08 - 00:17:44:06
What was the outcome of the hearing?
00:17:45:18 - 00:17:58:00
He was found guilty on all counts
and he was dismissed.

Moodley is currently taking legal action against these findings at the Commission for Conciliation, Mediation and Arbitration

Bryanston High school never opened a criminal case. Tayler was the only girl from school that pressed charges against Moodley.

00:27:21:03 - 00:27:25:13
I wanted to be perfect so that the things would stop happening, because that's what I thought.
00:28:24:17 - 00:28:28:15
I always blamed myself because I thought that there was more that I could have done.
00:28:29:22 - 00:28:33:18
But. Unfortunately, in that situation there wasn’t more I could


The state’s case Tayler cusens VS Aleshan Moodley has been postponed again to the 26th OF April. Moodley is yet to give his side of the story

When Carte Blanche approached Moodley’s lawyers for an interview they provided us with the following statement: our client denies any wrongdoing or unlawfulness.
based on the evidence led thus far in open court we believe our client will be acquitted of all charges
levelled against him.

Jenna-lee Shuttleworth has laid criminal charges against Moodley 12 years after the alleged assault took place and her case is finally being investigated

Jenna 00:15:49:05 - 00:16:20:02
I need people to understand that it was not me, it was not my fault. I was a child. I could not consent. He was an adult. He was a teacher. And I should have been protected
